questions.solution:

questions.question: Three of the following four number triads are alike in a certain way and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Option (1) (201, 402, 603) → All numbers are divisible by 3.

Option (2) (108, 300, 501) → All numbers are divisible by 3.

Option (3) (111, 222, 333) → All numbers are divisible by 3.

**Option (4) (202, 404, 909) → 202 and 404 are not divisible by 3.**

Hence, **‘Option (4)’** is the correct answer.

questions.question: Four numbers have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the one that is different.
questions.solution:
The logic is:

**1st Number × 3rd Number = 2ⁿd Number**

1) 600 → 6 × 0 = 0

2) 441 → 4 × 1 = 4

**3) 324 → 3 × 4 = 12 ≠ 2**

4) 393 → 3 × 3 = 9

Hence, ‘324’ is the odd one out.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

 
• All numbers are divisible by 3, so divisibility rule does not follow.
 
• **441 and 324 both are perfect square** of 21 and 18, so logic of a perfect square does not follow.

questions.question:
Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different. 

Pick the number that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

First digit × Second digit = Third digit × Fourth digit

**1) 6394 → 6 × 3 = 18 and 9 × 4 = 36**

2) 3864 → 3 × 8 = 24 and 6 × 4 = 24

3) 4638 → 4 × 6 = 24 and 3 × 8 = 24

4) 2936 → 2 × 9 = 18 and 3 × 6 = 18

Hence, 6394 is the odd one among the given alternatives.

questions.question: Four number triads have been given, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number triad that is different from the rest.

Four numbers have been given below, out of which three are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the number that is different from the rest.

132, 17523, 3164, 2695
questions.solution:
Given series: 132, 17523, 3164, 2695

Except 3164, all other numbers are completely divisible by 11.

1. 132 ÷ 11 = 12

2. 17523 ÷ 11 = 1593

3. 3164 ÷ 11 = **287.63**

4. 2695 ÷ 11 = 245

Hence, **3164 **is correct.
